descriptor.name: Tamil Nadu cadastral maps — indianopenmaps tile snapshot (TNGIS_TN_Cadastrals)
descriptor.scope: Cadastral parcels of Tamil Nadu from the TNGIS_TN_Cadastrals snapshot that ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals collected from the government map service and serves as vector tiles at indianopenmaps.com. Parcels are rebuilt from zoom-14 tiles. Coverage follows the villages in that snapshot and can omit city cores.
